data_fields.name: r8_city_min_rank_index
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (any non-first shrine in an R8 town)

best_idea: Score each zone point by a favour total, decay only the current leaders each day so the lead has to be defended, and pay the boon length by rank (40, 30, 20, 10, then nothing) with the favour spent per use.
decision_why: Keep the favour meter, the leader-only daily decay, the rank-scaled boon length and the cash-out; move the favour onto zone rows and pay cash-out through the loot path (one ledger, XP and loot only). Donor defects (no positivity guard on take, spend before power check, memory-only cash-out, decay log) are fixed in the sketch or listed. Item-currency wording rejected.
acceptance: A server test: after a daily tick a shrine with 100 favour in the top two of its type drops to 90 and one outside the top two keeps its total; a cash-out writes 0 to the stored row before any loot item is created; a take at 0 favour is refused by the server.
